title: estado machine graph
description: The static graph of an estado machine, as written by estado_graph::to_json (spec 8.1 and 8.2).

machine.description: Name of the machine: its root enum.

states.description: Every state, in declaration order. The index of a state in this array is its id.

edges.description: Every edge declared by a handler, in declaration order.

stateId.description: An index into the states array.

name.description: Name of the state, unique in the machine.

parent.description: The enclosing state or region; null for a top-level state.

kind.description: Atomic: leaf. Compound: has substates. Parallel: has regions. Region: a region of a parallel state. Final: a terminal state. Choice: a choice pseudostate.

initial.description: The initial substate of a compound state or region; null otherwise.

history.description: History kept by a compound state: none, the last direct substate (shallow) or the whole substate value (deep).

timers.description: Number of #[after] timers of the state.

invokes.description: Number of #[invoke] tasks of the state.

depth.description: Nesting depth; 0 for a top-level state.

from.description: The state whose handler declares the edge.

event.description: The event pattern of the match arm, when it could be extracted; null otherwise.

target.description: Where an edge ends: a state, a choice pseudostate, or a target decided at runtime.
